name: The Venetian Resort (Venetian / Palazzo towers)
resort_fee_excerpt: Rates include a daily Resort Fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable upon check-in.
tax_note: Clark County ordinance (Senate Bill 1, effective 1 March 2017), combined transient lodging tax schedule: 'Resort hotel within primary gaming corridor ... 13.38%'. Every Strip hotel in this table sits in the primary gaming corridor. Confirm the current schedule before relying on it.
parking: $20/day self-parking for registered hotel guests; $20 Mon-Thu / $25 Fri-Sun for non-guests; $40/day valet. Self-parking is free for the day to a poker-room player with 3 h or more of play (supervisor confirmation). The daily fee for registered hotel guests is $20/day, seven days a week. For non-hotel guests, the fee is $20/day Monday - Thursday, and $25/day Friday - Sunday. Valet parking is $40/day. ... Players in the poker room who play three hours or more in tournament or cash games will receive complimentary self-parking for the day. Players must visit a supervisor at the end of their session to confirm qualifications.
poker_rate: The only room rate an official Venetian page states in numbers: a published poker-suite rate starting at $119 (and $209) per night for a Luxury King Suite at single/double occupancy, with a $55 nightly resort fee, conditional on six hours of cash play or one $300+ tournament buy-in per night stayed, qualifying play completed before 2 a.m. on the last night. This is a published 'starting at' floor, not a dated quote for a specific stay, so it is kept as a rate-floor scenario in the dated log and never as the trip's confirmed hotel cost.
